title: proofgate-judges-pytest-by-the-command-word-of-each-segment
intention: bin/cmd/proofgate judges every segment by its command word, in both directions: pytest is refused only where it is the command word of a segment (past do/then/else, VAR=value assignments and the prefix commands, or after python -m), a segment counts as sealed only if its own command word is `cairn test`, a bash -c / sh -c / eval string is judged as the command it is, and segments are cut where the shell cuts, never inside quotes.
why: 1af0564c0db3 (PROVED, cairn b919a9a) refuses any Bash text containing the word pytest: measured 2026-10-06 by scratchpad probe pg_fp.py, `echo pytest`, `grep -rn pytest cairn/` and a commit message naming it are refused though they run no pytest; the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 reproduced `echo pytest` in its own session. The lived symptom: every session's innocent commands are blocked and must be respelled. Its clause (3) said other commands pass untouched, but its tooth never sampled the word as an argument, so the hollow went green. Also D9's measured miss: `X="a;b" python3 <proof>` passes bare because the split cuts inside the quotes. Widened 2026-10-06 at the peer's word (akiendelllinux_cc_0): ALREADY_SEALED was the same whole-text fault in reverse (`bin/cairn test a; python3 <proof>` passed bare), and wrapped spellings must be judged, not left to a WRONG INTENT clause. Measured on the way: the 1af0 gate did not refuse `bash -c "pytest x.py"` either — its regex wanted whitespace or a separator before the word, and a double quote is neither. Folded 2026-10-06 at the peer's word: _runs_a_proof matched any argument naming a proof, the same judge-by-text fault one level down. Measured: `python3 cross.py <tid> PROVEME bin "<why>" <proof>` was rewritten, the `cairn test --seal` beside it ran nested under --exec, bwrap could not create a namespace inside the outer seal, and the nested seal persisted a false RED.
traces_to: Law 9 (1af0's clause (3) 'other commands pass untouched' is red in the world); CP4 (a gate that blocks innocent commands chafes every session).
how: In bin/cmd/proofgate: replace the whole-text PYTEST and ALREADY_SEALED matches with _verdict(command) over _segments(command) — shlex.shlex(posix=True, punctuation_chars=True, whitespace ' \t\r', wordchars + '$@%+:,{}[]^!#'), cut at tokens made only of ;&|()\n, falling back to the old SEGMENT regex on unbalanced quotes. Per segment, _command_word skips KEYWORDS and assignments, and past a PREFIXES word takes the next judged word (python*, pytest, py.test, bash/sh/zsh/dash, eval, cairn). `cairn test` segment: skip. pytest word or python -m pytest: refuse. bash/sh -c <s> or eval <args>: recurse on the string (depth 4). python with a proof path/module/glob: rewrite. A rewrite still wraps the WHOLE command. The proof is already written red: bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py PROVES 72a37498c601 keys 1-5 (test_the_word_as_an_argument_passes_untouched, test_pytest_as_a_command_word_is_still_refused, test_a_separator_inside_an_assignment_hides_no_proof_run, test_a_wrapped_command_is_judged_as_the_command_it_is, test_cairn_test_seals_only_its_own_segment) plus the composite test_the_whole_fix_holds_end_to_end; red 5 of 14 at HEAD, 1af0564c0db3's 8 teeth green. Do not edit it; build against it. Then correct 1af0564c0db3's measured_at_build (4) through the artifact door: the hook went live mid-session. Clause (6), folded 2026-10-06: _runs_a_proof reads the SCRIPT SLOT only — walk python's args, skipping options (and the argument of -W/-X/-Q); -m takes the next token as the module; -c or - means no proof run; the first non-option token is the script, a proof if it matches PROOF_PATH, or a $var when PROOF_GLOB is in the command. Tooth 6 is test_a_proof_path_as_an_argument_is_not_a_proof_run, red at d67b1a01 (2 of 15).
falsifier: Done when (1) `git commit -m "refuses pytest\n"`, `grep -rn pytest cairn/`, `echo pytest` and `cat x | grep "py.test "` are judged None by bin/cmd/proofgate and pass the hook silently (exit 0, no stdout); (2) `pytest x.py`, `cd a && pytest`, `timeout 60 pytest cairn/tools/base/proofs/` and every spelling in the proof's PYTEST list are still refused with exit 2 naming `cairn test`; (3) `X="a;b" python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` is rewritten to `<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ` + shlex.quote(original); (4) `bash -c "pytest x.py"`, `sh -c 'pytest -q cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py'` and `eval "pytest x.py"` are refused, `bash -c "python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py"` is rewritten, `bash -c "echo pytest"` is judged None; (5) `echo "cairn test"; python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` and `bin/cairn test cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py; python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` are rewritten, and a rewritten command is judged None. (6) a proof path that is an argument to some other script is not a proof run: `python3 cross.py 72a37498c601 PROVEME bin "why" cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` and `python3 -c 'print(1)' cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` are judged None and the first passes the hook silently, while `python3 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py`, `python3 -u cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py --verbose` and `python3 -X dev cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py` are still rewritten. WRONG INTENT if a pytest run or proof run reachable through a spelling this segment judgement cannot see is measured in the corpus of CC Bash commands (then the gate needs a shell grammar, not segments).

decisions.text: KEYWORDS = {do, then, else, elif, !, {} — skipped before the command word, as are VAR=value assignments. PREFIXES is the existing set in bin/cmd/proofgate, unchanged: timeout, strace, env, nice, nohup, stdbuf, time, ionice, setsid, exec. Past a prefix the command word is the next token whose basename is python*, pytest, py.test, bash, sh, zsh, dash, eval or cairn. PROOF_PATH, PROOF_MODULE, PROOF_GLOB and the SEGMENT regex (the fallback on unbalanced quotes) stay as they are. At depth 4 a nested string is not judged further (that string yields None). The teeth are named in the ticket's how; build against bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py until all 14 teeth are green.
